summary: FE click-through verified for Harga Internal Antar-PT flow inside FulfillmentDecisionDialog. Setup via API: created TEST_ SO KANDA/SO-00003 (prod_ulos_batak, allow_backorder) in Kanda and temporarily terminated the active KSC→Kanda internal contract (sct_519eb36b4d4c) to force price-missing state. UI phase 1 (salesadmin.kanda / demo1234): opened Meja Admin Sales → clicked 'Putuskan pemenuhan' on KANDA/SO-00003 → FulfillmentDecisionDialog opened; the 'Transfer dari Sukacita' row shows badge fulfill-ic-price-missing-prod_ulos_batak-ent_ksc, qty input fulfill-ic-prod_ulos_batak-ent_ksc is disabled, fulfill-create-price button is HIDDEN (correct — salesadmin lacks interco_price.set); clicked fulfill-request-price-prod_ulos_batak-ent_ksc → fulfill-notice shows 'Permintaan dikirim ke 3 orang (MD/Finance/Admin).' and button text becomes 'Permintaan terkirim' (disabled). UI phase 2 (admin / demo12345, entity ent_kanda): fulfill-create-price-prod_ulos_batak-ent_ksc visible → internal-price-modal opens → filled 100000 → internal-price-preview visible → internal-price-save → modal detaches → fulfill-notice shows 'Harga internal ULS-BTK-001 tersimpan — transfer sekarang bisa dijalankan.' → plan reloaded → fulfill-ic-price-prod_ulos_batak-ent_ksc now reads 'Harga internal Rp 100.000 / yard', qty input enabled. Pagination render check: ?view=supplier-items, ?view=color-library, ?view=reorder all render without crash. CLEANUP done: TEST SO cancelled, original internal contract restored to active, new internal contract created by admin's modal (sct_a210f6e93cd5) terminated.
critical_code_review_comments: FulfillmentLineCard.jsx correctly gates the two buttons on canSetPrice prop (sourced from data.can_set_internal_price, which the backend sets per actor permission interco_price.set). Verified end-to-end in UI.

InternalPriceModal.jsx uses internalPriceBulk → POST /api/interco/prices/bulk with a single item. The flow succeeds and triggers plan reload via onSaved→load() in FulfillmentDecisionDialog — row flips from missing-badge to price-ready in one UX pass.
FulfillmentDecisionDialog.initLine filters proposed interco qty to only entities with price_ready!==false, so a missing-price seller never pre-fills qty — correct guard.
Admin entity switch via URL param '?view=sales-admin-desk&entity=ent_kanda' is honored and causes the Kanda queues to appear — no explicit switcher click needed.
The 'Minta harga internal' request endpoint returns a user-readable Indonesian message that the UI surfaces verbatim via fulfill-notice — good UX.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The full FulfillmentDecisionDialog interco price flow is now exercised end-to-end from the UI (iteration_154 covered backend + testid existence; iteration_155 covers clicks). Setup/teardown helper lives at /app/test_reports/iter155_setup.py (run with no args to seed, --teardown to cleanup).
